summary: Iteration 2 tested the Emergent Google auth and per-user isolation, plus an authenticated regression. Backend: rewrote test_folgasmart_api.py to use Bearer auth with users created in pymongo. 30/30 pass. Covered: 401 without a session on employees/movement/schedule/auth/me and on mutations; invalid Bearer gives 401; POST /auth/session with an invalid session_id gives 401; expired session gives 401; cookie auth works; logout by cookie invalidates the session; a new user does not see legacy data; A/B isolation for employees (list, delete 404, PUT 404, cell 404), movement peaks and schedule; CRUD; whitespace validation (now 422); CSV import with BR thousands '1.234' (now 1234); peaks; generate 6x1/5x2; toggle; unknown employee toggle (now 404); delete removes the employee's schedule entry; legacy data untouched. Frontend: / without a cookie goes to /login. btn-google-login goes to auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>%2F. #session_id=invalid shows the toast 'Não foi possível entrar' and goes to /login. With the cookie: dashboard loads, user-name shows the name, add 3 employees, import CSV (peaks Sex/Sáb/Dom detected), manual peak toggle, 5x2 gives 2/2 and 6x1 gives 1/1, sector tabs filter (Cozinha: 1 row, 1 group), cell toggle TRAB./FOLGA, CSV export escala-6x1.csv, delete employee. Logout returns to /login, /api/auth/me then returns 401, and / redirects again. Mobile 390: scrollWidth=390 (no overflow), user-name is hidden and the avatar and logout button are visible. No console errors.

minor.issue: Only reads the session_token cookie. Logout with only Authorization: Bearer does not delete the session (the frontend uses the cookie, so it works in the UI).
If the Emergent payload lacks email or name, info['email'] raises KeyError and returns 500. There is no error handling for httpx timeouts either (500).

issues: The header still takes ~183px (3 rows). It is no longer sticky on mobile, so this is acceptable.

action_items: Optional: make logout also accept a Bearer token
Optional: handle a malformed or failed Emergent session-data response in /auth/session (return 401/502 instead of 500)
critical_code_review_comments: user_sessions has no TTL index, so expired sessions accumulate. Consider db.user_sessions.create_index('expires_at', expireAfterSeconds=0).

ProtectedRoute trusts location.state.user and skips /auth/me. Harmless because the APIs return 401, but if a 401 occurs mid-session the Dashboard should redirect to /login (consider an axios 401 interceptor).

claim_legacy_data runs only for brand-new users created via /auth/session. That is correct, but it is not atomic: two simultaneous first logins could split employees and movement/schedule between users. This is an edge case.
test_credentials: No fixed credentials (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test users and sessions are created in Mongo: the pytest fixture creates them and cleans them up; the UI user was created via mongosh.
seed_data_creation: All test users, sessions, employees, movement and schedule docs were removed at the end. Legacy data was preserved: 6 employees without user_id, plus movement and schedule with _key 'main'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest backend/tests/test_folgasmart_api.py. It creates its own A/B users in pymongo and cleans up. test_legacy_data_untouched expects 6 legacy employees (update it if a real Google login claims them). In Playwright, add the session_token cookie for domain escala-5x2.preview.emergentagent.com. The peak indicators are peak-day-indicator-{segunda..domingo}.
